headline: IT services showed mixed revenue growth with AI driving upside for several firms.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from low single digits to over 50% YoY. AI‑related revenue and deal wins were highlighted by Infosys, LTM, Mphasis, HCLTech and TCS. Margin guidance was raised by Coforge, while profit fell at Wipro. Guidance outlook remains modest across the sector.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: AI contributed strong top‑line growth and larger deals at multiple companies.

themes.title: Margin guidance upgrades
themes.detail: Coforge lifted its FY27 EBIT margin target, reflecting confidence in profitability.

leaders.why: Revenue grew 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Revenue up 13.6% YoY with AI‑led services surging 47%.

laggards.why: Revenue grew modestly 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9%.
Revenue grew 30.3% YoY but profit dropped 25.4%.
